frozen_v1_pipeline: RGB 3-channel; aspect-preserving resize (min(512/w,512/h)); symmetric pad to 512; image BILINEAR; mask NEAREST; resize extent max(1,round(extent*scale))

Stones_where_are_you.mask: COCO polygon rasterized to binary at native res, then NEAREST resize

empty_and_padding: external padding excluded from ROI area; mask binarize = (mask>0)
